name: Service provider evidence matrix
summary: When a material service provider needs approval or renewal, the vendor owner gets one matrix: the provider's evidence set against the firm's own review criteria, with self-attestations, dated reports and untested claims kept apart from independent evidence, and every unanswered question listed.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of the work of reviewing a service provider's evidence, with the method written for this template.
